business_summary: Ningbo Zhoushan Port Company Limited operates as a container ocean trunk port in China. The company's terminal functions include container terminal facilities; iron ore professional terminal; crude oil terminal; liquid chemical raw material; coal transshipment, storage, and transportation base; and cruise terminal services. It also offers port services, such as pilotage, ship tally, container loading and unpacking, cargo measurement, easy-to-fluidize solid bulk cargo sampling, and cargo damage and container inspection services. In addition, the company provides sea-rail transport logistics, domestic trade, shipping agency, port area freight forwarding, container logistics yard, railway liquefied product transportation and agency, cargo warehousing and full transportation, handling ship entry and exit procedures, contact arrangements for pilotage; signing bills of lading, and transportation contracts business. Further, the company handles customs declaration procedures for ships, containers, and goods; handles consignment and transit of goods and containers, and settlement and other projects; undertakes non-vessel operations; and collects freight. Additionally, it offers land bridge railway transportation, multimodal transportation, railway transit, export transportation, container rental, and other services. Furthermore, the company engages in software research and development, system integration, security engineering, and communication services. The company was formerly known as Ningbo Port Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ningbo Zhoushan Port Company Limited in August 2016. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Ningbo, China. Ningbo Zhoushan Port Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Ningbo Zhoushan Port Group Limited.
business_summary_ko: Ningbo Zhoushan Port Company Limited는 중국의 컨테이너 해양 트렁크 항구로 운영됩니다. 회사의 터미널 기능에는 컨테이너 터미널 시설; 철광석 전문 터미널; 원유 터미널; 액체 화학 원료; 석탄 환적, 저장 및 운송 기지; 크루즈 터미널 서비스. 또한 도선, 선박 집계, 컨테이너 선적 및 포장 풀기, 화물 측정, 유동화하기 쉬운 고체 벌크 화물 샘플링, 화물 손상 및 컨테이너 검사 서비스와 같은 항만 서비스도 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 해상 철도 운송 물류, 국내 무역, 해운 대행, 항만 지역 화물 운송, 컨테이너 물류 야적장, 철도 액화 제품 운송 및 대행, 화물 창고 및 전체 운송, 선박 입출항 절차 처리, 도선 연락 준비 등을 제공합니다. 선하 증권 서명 및 운송 계약 사업. 또한 회사는 선박, 컨테이너 및 물품에 대한 세관 신고 절차를 처리합니다. 상품 및 컨테이너의 위탁 및 운송, 정산 및 기타 프로젝트를 처리합니다. 선박 이외의 작업을 수행합니다. 그리고 화물을 수집합니다. 또한, 랜드 브리지도 제공합니다.
